envelope.description: Prepare immutable bundle candidates with bounded safe extraction

body.title: Prepare immutable bundle candidates with bounded safe extraction
body.summary: Implement bundle delivery resolution/download, sidecar/schema/inventory checks and streaming bounded ZIP staging/publication using the approved yauzl reader. Return the common prepared candidate without selecting or starting it.
acceptanceChecks: Reject traversal/drive/UNC/ADS/backslash ambiguities, symlinks/special files, duplicates/case collisions, encryption/unsupported entries and entry/byte/ratio/size violations before unsafe execution/publication.
Check all runtime/target/predecessor/entrypoint and inventory identities; never run npm/build on consumers or silently switch bundle to dev.
Download/cancel/build-input failures clean only owned staging and preserve incumbent selection/data/running intent; retry revalidates the exact immutable candidate.

tests.name: hostile ZIP corpus cannot escape staging or exceed bounded extraction
download digest target runtime cancellation and retry preserve incumbent
